ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; visible surface is predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) with high-intensity pixels (<5%) restricted to distal barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity spatial mapping; absence of high-contrast contiguous geometric blobs, mottling, or focal spots on the main fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate aperture of 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 4-12 pixels along the continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the trailing edge boundary, terminating in tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured clusters of roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle accumulation and associated scarring at the distal-most points of the fluke lobes.
